2653-2893-8336-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

277-1021-5413-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7650--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

620-1429-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

967-3809-5256-7087-7824.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2488-6780-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Your Temple Is Under Attack by paying its mana cost, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-6780-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

2034-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-2528-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2292-2528-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

140-3245-3859.description:
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

1824-2530-3168-4740.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-3168-4740.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3168-4740.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1978-3053-7329.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-7329.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

643-6291-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Maskwood Nexus, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat step 3.
643-6291-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

3713-4289-4316-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1659-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1659-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

11-2103-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2103-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Capture of Jingzhou from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2854-4211-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4574-6650.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-3652-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-5326-6913.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least X power.
2092-3719-5326-6913.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Chameleon and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Chameleon to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Chameleon by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1725-6614.description:
At the beginning of each draw step, Omen Machine prevents the active player from drawing a card, and causes them to exile the top card of their library, and cast that card if its a spell without paying its mana cost, or put it onto the battlefield if it's a land.
If a player casts a spell this way, Vexing Bauble triggers, countering that spell.

2034-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2034-5968-5972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2034-6431--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

2018-2099-5570.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

539-2244-3480-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-3480-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

1479-3478-3908.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

4050-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4050-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4050-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding one mana of any color.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-2051-2546-4566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1742-2051-2546-4566.description:
Activate Barren Moor's cycling ability by paying {B} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Barren Moor ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card, adding {B}.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Barren Moor and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

369-650-5256.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-650-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Iridescent Drake's power.
Repeat.

69-539-2050-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Arbor Elf do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-2050-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-2050-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

784-1230-1558.notablePrerequisites:
Both of your commanders are on the battlefield under your control.
Your commanders do not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by your opponents.
784-1230-1558.description:
Declare Silas Renn and your other commander as attackers, attacking the opponent with the highest life total among your opponents and/or an opponent who is tied for the highest life total among your opponents.
Silas Renn and your other commander trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing it and the four Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage with Silas Renn.
Silas Renn triggers, allowing you to cast Time Sieve from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Time Sieve by paying {U}{B}.
Repeat each turn.

1433-4131-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Mightstone's Animation attached to Basalt Monolith.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1433-4131-4639.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Basalt Monolith to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Basalt Monolith triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {C}{C}{C}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

152-1283-1434-2557.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery copies first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' second abilities to draw infinite cards.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-5147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Dargo for {R}.
392-3327-5147.description:
Cast Dargo by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2174-2605-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-2605-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
